question: Which of the following rocky planets is the fastest planet in our solar system - traveling through space at about 29 miles (47 kilometres) per second?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mercury**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mercury** is the **fastest planet **in our solar system, traveling through space at about 29 miles (47 kilometers) per second.
 
• It is the **closest planet to the Sun**, which contributes to its high orbital speed.
 
• Mercury completes one orbit around the Sun in just **88 Earth days**.</
